svg.title: Optical train of the line-scan spectrograph
svg.desc: Top view, not to scale. Light from the object reflects off a scan mirror, passes a long-pass filter and an objective lens, comes to a focus at a slit, is collimated by a second lens, and is dispersed by a transmission grating. A tilted Pi NoIR camera images the dispersed light so that 500 nm and 1000 nm land at different places on the sensor. An RGB pose camera is mounted alongside.
